cases.description: An Express JSON object crosses three relative-import boundaries into a source operand of lodash.merge under a nearest runtime manifest pinned to vulnerable Lodash 4.17.10, allowing constructor.prototype traversal to modify Object.prototype and supply inherited authorization state.
The same Express and three-relay topology reaches lodash.merge, but the nearest runtime manifest pins patched Lodash 4.17.21 and therefore excludes the historical vulnerable-version model.

An Express JSON object crosses three relative-import boundaries into a source operand of lodash.merge under a nearest runtime manifest range whose fresh npm v3 lockfile resolves vulnerable Lodash 4.17.10, allowing constructor.prototype traversal to modify Object.prototype and supply inherited authorization state.

The same Express and three-relay topology reaches lodash.merge under the same manifest range, but its fresh npm v3 lockfile resolves patched Lodash 4.17.21 and excludes the historical vulnerable-version model.

An Express JSON object crosses three relative-import boundaries into a source operand of the standalone lodash.merge package under a nearest runtime manifest pinned to vulnerable version 4.6.1, allowing constructor.prototype traversal to modify Object.prototype and supply inherited authorization state.

The same Express and three-relay topology reaches the standalone lodash.merge package, but the nearest runtime manifest pins patched version 4.6.2 and therefore excludes the historical vulnerable-version model.

An Express JSON object crosses three relative-import boundaries into a source operand of merge-deep under a nearest runtime manifest pinned to vulnerable version 3.0.2, allowing constructor.prototype traversal to modify Object.prototype and supply inherited authorization state.
The same Express and three-relay topology reaches merge-deep, but the nearest runtime manifest pins patched version 3.0.3 and therefore excludes the historical vulnerable-version model.

An Express JSON object crosses three relative-import boundaries into a source operand of extend(true, target, ...sources) under a nearest runtime manifest pinned to vulnerable version 3.0.1, allowing constructor.prototype traversal to modify Object.prototype and supply inherited authorization state.

The same Express and three-relay topology reaches extend(true, target, ...sources), but the nearest runtime manifest pins patched version 3.0.2 and therefore excludes the historical vulnerable-version model.
